NONE: › belonging to or relating to the Netherlands, its people, or its language
荷蘭的；荷蘭人的；荷蘭語的
› the main language spoken in the Netherlands, also spoken in Belgium
› the confidence that some people get from drinking alcohol before they do something that needs courage
› a disease that slowly kills elm trees
› If good are dutiable, duty must be paid on them.
› doing everything that you should do

example: a dutiful son/husband
孝順的兒子／有責任感的丈夫

C or U: B1 something that you have to do because it is part of your job, or something that you feel is the right thing to do
› to have to do something because it is your duty
› a tax paid to the government, especially on things that you bring into a country

example: The duty of the agency is to act in the best interests of the child.
這個機構的責任就是爲孩子謀取最大利益。
[ + to infinitive ] I felt it was my duty to tell them the truth.
我覺得我有責任告訴他們真相。
You have a duty to yourself to take a break once in a while.
偶爾你該給自己放個假。
He only went to see her out of duty (= because he thought he should).
他去看她只是出於義務。
You should report for duty (= arrive at work) at 8 a.m. on Monday.
你應該在週一上午八點報到。
What time are you off/on duty (= when do you finish/start work) tomorrow?
明天你幾點下／上班？
We are duty bound to justify how we spend our funds.
我們有義務把資金使用情況說清楚。
There's a high duty on alcohol.
酒類的關稅很高。

NONE: B1 Duty-free goods are goods bought in special shops in airports, on ships, etc. on which you do not pay government tax.

U: › [ U ] goods that you can buy in special shops in airports, on ships, etc., without paying tax on them
（在機場或船上等的）免稅商品
C: › [ C ] also duty-free shop a shop at an airport, on a ship, etc. where you can buy duty-free goods

example: He bought his wife some duty-free perfume.
他給妻子買了一些免稅香水。
I bought some perfume in the duty-free shop.
我在免稅店買了一些香水。
We can buy our duty-free while we're waiting at the airport.
我們在機場候機時可以買些免稅商品。
There'll be a duty-free on the ferry.
輪船上有免稅店。
